title: Assessing conditions favoring the survival of African dust-borne microorganisms during long-range transport across the tropical Atlantic
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,220-241
DOI: 10.1039/D4EA00093E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ali Hossein Mardi, Miguel Ricardo A. Hilario, Regina Hanlon, Cristina González Martín, David Schmale, Armin Sorooshian, Hosein Foroutan
Shorter travel distance, lower solar radiation and higher relative humidity create a more suitable environment for the survivability of microorganisms onboard dust plumes traveling across the Atlantic Ocean from December to February.
